description: Per-batch fill-finish attestation. Wave 1 (sterile eye drop BFS, ADR-2605250530) + Wave 1b (non-sterile tablet + topical, ADR-2605250600). Captures formulation lot, upstream API source CIDs, excipient lots, dosage-form-specific parameters (BFS for eye drop sterile / compression for tablet / emulsification for topical). G9 N≥2 signatures (operator + QP). dosageForm field discriminates sterile vs non-sterile QC requirements (sterileFilter / CCIT / sterility / endotoxin required only for sterile dosage forms; dissolution / disintegration / friability / viscosity required for tablet / topical).

dosageForm.description: Wave 1 = 'eye-drop-sterile-*'. Wave 1b adds tablet + topical. Wave 1c adds sachets + oral liquid (cough syrups, laxative solutions). Wave 1c+ adds remaining unit-dose, liquid injectable as separate ADRs.

apiConcentrationMicrogPerMl.description: Eye drop / topical liquid concentrations in micrograms per mL (integer). DSCG = 20000 (20.0 mg/mL), naphazoline = 500 (0.5 mg/mL), chlorpheniramine eye drop = 300 (0.3 mg/mL).

apiStrengthMicrogPerUnit.description: Wave 1b tablet/capsule strength per dosage unit in micrograms (integer). Acetaminophen 500 mg = 500000; ibuprofen 200 mg = 200000; cetirizine 10 mg = 10000; famotidine 10 mg = 10000.

apiConcentrationBp.description: Wave 1b topical concentration as %w/w in parts per million (integer; 10000 = 1.00%). Clotrimazole 1% = 10000, diclofenac sodium gel 1% = 10000.

excipientAttestationUris.description: rawMaterialAttestation URIs for NaCl, citric acid, sodium citrate, etc.

wfiBatchId.description: Required for sterile dosage forms (eye-drop-sterile-*). NA for tablet / topical Wave 1b.

sterileFilterLotId.description: Required for sterile dosage forms only.

sterileFilterPoreSizeNm.description: Sterile filter pore size in nanometers (integer). 220 = standard 0.22 µm sterile-grade default.

sterileFilterIntegrityPassed.description: Bubble point or diffusion flow integrity test result.

bfsRunParamsCid.description: Temperature, pressure, cycle time, blow / fill / seal parameters.

envMonitoringCid.description: Class A air particle count + viable count time-series during fill.

endotoxinMilliEuPerMl.description: Bacterial endotoxin in milli-EU per mL (integer; 1000 = 1.0 EU/mL ophthalmic upper limit). LAL gel-clot result × 1000.

bottlesProduced.description: Eye drop sterile only. For tablet / topical use unitsProduced.

unitsProduced.description: Generic unit count for all dosage forms: bottles (eye drop), tablets (oral), tubes (topical).

tabletPressEquipmentDid.description: Wave 1b tablet only. Tablet press DID for compression step traceability.

tabletCompressionForceN.description: Wave 1b tablet only. Compression force in Newtons (integer; kN × 1000). Typical 5000-25000 N for OTC tablets.

topicalMixerEquipmentDid.description: Wave 1b topical only. High-shear homogenizer / mixer DID.

topicalEmulsificationTempDeciC.description: Wave 1b topical only. Emulsification temperature in deci-degrees Celsius (integer; °C × 10). 700-750 = typical 70.0-75.0°C range.

operatorDid.description: Generic operator DID for any dosage form (replaces bfsOperatorDid as required field; bfsOperatorDid kept for sterile BFS legacy).

bfsOperatorDid.description: Sterile BFS-specific operator DID. Aliased to operatorDid for sterile dosage forms.
